context.requirement_text: One of four sibling migration requirements splitting REQ-141's original 47-file / 496-occurrence component migration (REQ-VALIDATOR FAILed the combined draft for sizing -- see REQ-141's description for the full rationale). This requirement covers web/src/components/canvas/ only: 15 files, 118 hex-literal occurrences as re-verified against this worktree on 2026-08-22 via `grep -rEon "#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}" web/src/components/canvas/ --include='*.tsx' --include='*.ts'` (re-verify again at this requirement's own start since counts drift). Replace each literal with the matching var(--token-name) from web/src/styles/tokens.css (built by REQ-141). If a component needs a color design-system.md's current palette does not cover, that is a design-step addendum (name the new token and why, get it added to design-system.md and tokens.css), not a silent invention during implementation. This requirement is independent of REQ-143, REQ-144, and REQ-145 -- it touches only canvas/ and does not depend on any of the other three sibling migrations landing first or after.

no file outside web/src/components/canvas/ is modified by this requirement, confirmed by `git diff --stat` scoped to this requirement's commits
the existing component test suite for web/src/components/canvas/ passes unchanged (no test assertions altered to accommodate the color-value change)
npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run guards all pass from web/, with real output quoted
